title: A Features Hub You Can Actually Filter and Share | vitalii.no
description:
Every feature on vitalii.no used to live on its own isolated page with no central listing a visitor -- or a search engine -- could actually browse or filter. There was no way to see 'everything in media production' or 'everything from one project', and sharing a single feature meant sharing a full page reload with no sense of where it sat among the rest.

I built a /features hub page backed by a cached Supabase query, so filtering by category or project badge never re-hits the database. Selecting a feature updates the URL with its own id and category params and opens a modal in place, so any filtered view or single feature is a shareable, bookmarkable link. The hub and every individual feature page are both included in the sitemap.

Features are now browsable by category and project, individually shareable via deep link, and both the hub and each feature page are crawlable by search engines -- turning a pile of disconnected pages into an actual indexed section of the site.
